Announcement Text: North Trailhead Only: Use North Trailhead entrance for parking, staging grids, and pit zones.
Parking Pass: Wood County Park vehicle pass or daily entrance fee required at park entry.
Staging & Call-ups: Riders must report to staging grids 15 minutes prior to their wave start.
Pit Zone & Camping: Team tents in designated LAXMTB Team space. Quiet hours 10 PM - 6 AM.
Leashed Pets Only: Dogs prohibited in active course areas and staging grid zones.
Venue Entrance: Follow Birkie Trailhead signs to Carlson Competition Stadium.
Trail Passes: Spectator admission is free, but CAMBA trail passes required for recreational riding.
